about: Beaumont is a town in Alberta’s Capital Region, just south of Edmonton toward Nisku and the airport corridor. Rapid suburban growth has transformed former farmland into family neighbourhoods while a compact downtown and French heritage roots remain visible. Highways 814 and 625 link it into the Edmonton metro area. About 21,000 people live in Beaumont.
